facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog says the U-shaped (position-based) attribution model assigns 40% of credit to both the first and last touch point.
facts.quote: Also known as position-based attribution, this model assigns 40% of credit to both the first and last touch, and then divides the remaining credit between the mid-funnel touch points.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog says the W-shaped attribution model assigns 30% of credit to the point where a prospect becomes a lead, and divides the remaining 10% among other touch points.
facts.quote: as well as 30% credit to the point between the two when a prospect becomes a lead. The remaining 10% is divided among other touch points.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog says the W-shaped attribution model assigns the remaining 10% of credit among other touch points.
